newsitem.title: USA: Lucent Technologies says logo legally sound.
newsitem.headline: Lucent Technologies says logo legally sound.

text.p: Lucent Technologies, being sued for trademark infringement, said on Friday it had taken the proper steps to ensure it could use the Lucent name.

In court papers Lucent Information Management of Bala Cynwyd, Pa. alleged on Thursday Lucent Technologies knew the "Lucent" trademark had already been adopted but decided not to be "inconvenienced" by a similarly named small company without an "established identity."
"While we haven't yet seen the lawsuit, we're confident we've taken proper steps to insure we can use the name Lucent Technologies," company spokeswoman Lynda Beighley said.
